# VisitDenmark

> > Official tourism guide to Denmark featuring Copenhagen, Aarhus, Jutland, and Danish culture from pastries to friluftsliv.

VisitDenmark is the national tourism organization promoting travel to Denmark, covering major destinations like Copenhagen, Aarhus, Odense, and Jutland, along with Danish cultural traditions, museums, outdoor activities, and culinary experiences. The site serves both leisure travelers and business event planners with comprehensive guides to attractions, neighborhoods, and practical travel information.

## Key Topics

- Copenhagen
- Jutland
- Aarhus
- Odense
- Hans Christian Andersen
- Danish culture and traditions
- Friluftsliv (outdoor lifestyle)
- Danish pastries and cuisine
- Museums and art galleries
- LGBTQ+ travel
- Sustainable tourism
- Viking heritage
- Tivoli Gardens
- North Jutland beaches
- Copenhagen neighborhoods

## Destinations & Regional Guides

- [Where is Denmark? Wow...let us fill you in!](https://www.visitdenmark.com/denmark/things-do/x-visit-denmark-home/denmarks-natural-wonders-google-street-view): Overview of Denmark's attractions and destinations including Copenhagen, Aarhus
- [Jutland, wild beaches and packed with history](https://www.visitdenmark.com/denmark/destinations/jutland): Jutland guide: UNESCO sites, West Coast beaches, LEGOLAND, Ribe, Aarhus
- [Copenhagen neighbourhoods you should explore](https://www.visitdenmark.com/denmark/destinations/copenhagen/neighbourhoods): Copenhagen districts guide: Vesterbro, Nørrebro, Meatpacking District
- [Seaside Hotels in Northern Jutland](https://www.visitdenmark.com/denmark/destinations/jutland/seaside-hotels-north-jutland): Badehoteller seaside hotels in North Jutland including Ruth's Hotel Skagen

## Culture & Attractions

- [The best museums to visit to understand us Danes better](https://www.visitdenmark.com/denmark/things-to-do/attractions/best-museums): Top 18 Danish museums: National Gallery, ARoS, Viking heritage collections
- [Join us in the underworld](https://www.visitdenmark.com/denmark/things-do/attractions/underground-adventures): Underground attractions: Stevnsfort Cold War Museum, Copenhagen caves, ruins
- [There's more to Denmark than Danish pastries](https://www.visitdenmark.com/denmark/things-to-do/eat-drink/pastries-cakes-biscuits): Guide to Danish pastries, wienerbrod, and best bakeries in Copenhagen
- [What is friluftsliv?](https://www.visitdenmark.com/denmark/things-to-do/outdoor-nature/friluftsliv): Friluftsliv explained: Danish outdoor lifestyle and nature activities

## Travel Planning & Visitor Information

- [LGBTQ+ in Denmark](https://www.visitdenmark.com/denmark/plan-your-trip/lbgtq-friendly-travel): LGBTQ+ travel guide: Copenhagen Pride, Aarhus Pride, and equality info
- [Plan your visit](https://www.visitdenmark.com/denmark-pavillion/various-ol/plan-your-visit): Denmark Pavilion Paris 2024 visitor info: hours, accessibility, location

## Danish Traditions & Culture Stories

- [Five football traditions that only make sense to Danes](https://www.visitdenmark.com/denmark/various/history/football-traditions): Danish football fan culture explained: klaphat, boat chants, and traditions
- [Shrove Tuesday: Four Quirky Danish Pancake Traditions](https://www.visitdenmark.com/press/latest-news/quirky-danish-pancake-tradition): Danish Shrove Tuesday pancake traditions at Tivoli and Copenhagen Town Hall

- [Sustainable Copenhagen is "Best of the World 2021"](https://www.visitdenmark.com/press/latest-news/sustainable-copenhagen-best-world-2021): National Geographic names Copenhagen Best of World 2021 for sustainability
- [The World's Best Chefs Come Together in Copenhagen](https://www.visitdenmark.com/press/press-room/convergence): CONVERGENCE global culinary event at Michelin-star Alchemist in Copenhagen
- [Scandic Falkoner – expanded and refurbished](https://www.visitdenmark.com/business-events/news/scandic-falkoner-expanded-and-refurbished): Scandic Falkoner conference hotel refurbishment by Arkitema near Frederiksberg
